V1: Real permitted pages from all three sources → immutable evidence → persistent BM25+dense indexes → hybrid API/cards; inference config probed; externally accessible initial deployment and restart demonstrated. All task acceptance gates, not code count, required.
V2: Integrated multilingual/absence/grounding/fairness/lifecycle/feedback/admin checks, measured Core performance/cost and full local network-blocked unseen query including Apertus 8B. Missing evidence keeps gate open.
V3: Editable requirements and batched validated streamed enrichment preserve fast path; complete required ablations/cross-encoder subset and actual partner review/fixes. Tier labels remain independent of milestone.
V4: Public final smoke test, honest measured report, ≤10-slide pitch PDF, ≤6-page report PDF, ≤2-minute public video/backup, required PDF ZIP and actual submission confirmation. Stretch remains deferred unless Core accepted and buffer protected.

tasks.title: Ratify contracts, stack and shared ownership
tasks.steps: Review the proposed contracts and minimal stack with the team. Name one contract owner and one dispatcher/integration owner (roles may be held by the same developer). Freeze v1 schemas, repository boundaries, error semantics, metric definitions and pending lifecycle decisions before coding. Record approvals and deviations; do not pretend this proposal is already approved.
tasks.acceptance: Team approval and named roles are recorded; every cross-workstream record/API has an owner and version; fixtures can be implemented independently; freshness/removal defaults are explicitly accepted or remain blocking their dependent work. Check architecture compatibility and all contract references.
tasks.blocker: No dependency; documentation review is immediately actionable. Implementation remains gated on explicit plan approval.

tasks.title: Audit source inventory and real-page evaluation seeds
tasks.steps: Locate the supplied inventory or document its absence; inspect public seed pages and robots for UniBE, ARTORG and Diabetes Center Berne without bypassing controls. Propose bounded URLs/paths, focus-area tags, HTML/text-PDF examples and unsupported cases. Collect source-grounded query/entity candidates without scoring a system.
tasks.acceptance: A reproducible source manifest covers all three institutions or identifies exact missing inventory/access; seed evidence URLs and language/type are recorded; no invented source matches or crawl coverage. Review allowed paths and unsupported formats. Full acceptance requires confirmed inventory.
tasks.blocker: Missing organiser inventory may block final acceptance; discovery can start without application code.

tasks.title: Audit endpoint, hosting and local-hardware access
tasks.steps: Inventory CSCS/Keera access, endpoint/model names, judging continuity, structured-output/streaming expectations, hosting access, and local 8B hardware/storage. Choose one concrete hosting target with the dispatcher from existing authorised resources; propose a single-container persistent-volume deployment. Prepare model/dependency download plan and opt-in probe checklist. Record only secret variable names, never values. No purchase, provisioning or billing acceptance.
tasks.acceptance: A redacted access matrix names actual available resources or explicit blockers; one deployment path is selected if access exists; local memory/model-license/download feasibility and required approvals are recorded. An unavailable resource remains a blocker, not a fabricated pass.
tasks.blocker: Read-only audit is immediately actionable; live access/hardware may remain external blockers.

tasks.title: Create contract-first application and CI skeleton
tasks.files: app/main.py; app/contracts.py; tests/contracts/; pyproject.toml; .gitignore; Dockerfile; CI configuration
tasks.steps: Implement the approved Python/FastAPI single-server skeleton, SQLite repository interface, static UI shell and deterministic fixtures. Add contract validation, health/readiness distinction, reproducible dependency locking/container startup and proportionate CI. Ignore local data, models, .env and logs. Do not implement retrieval or inference here.
tasks.acceptance: Clean environment starts documented container; deterministic contract tests validate fixture/error/version behavior; CI uses no paid/live inference; readiness is false until required corpus/index assets are loaded; no secrets in tracked files. Record exact commands, not assumed install success.
tasks.blocker: Plan approval and T01 contract ratification required.

tasks.title: Configure and probe replaceable CSCS/Keera inference
tasks.steps: Configure endpoint, API key and 8B/optional 70B model IDs server-side. Add replaceable local endpoint, connectivity and available-model opt-in smoke tests, actual structured-decoding and streaming probes, timeouts, bounded retry/backoff, concurrency limits and token/latency instrumentation. Keep credentials out of client bundles/logs. Implement deterministic fake endpoint tests; live API tests require opt-in and fictional input. Document validated JSON retry fallback as weaker than backend-constrained decoding.
tasks.acceptance: Actual endpoint probe report distinguishes unsupported/unknown features; malformed output, rate limits, timeout and unavailable inference fail safely; keyword path does not depend on adapter. Inspect built client/static assets and logs for secret leakage. No live paid call in routine CI. Full live acceptance blocks if endpoint credentials are unavailable.
tasks.blocker: Requires usable authorised endpoint credentials for live gate; no confidential profiles.

tasks.title: Implement bounded initial crawl and immutable evidence storage
tasks.steps: Load YAML registry; discover via sitemaps/internal links within allowlists, robots and domain rate limits; fetch public HTML/text PDFs once. Store URL/redirect/hash/fetch/content dates, versioned passages and sentence IDs with PDF page numbers. Clean boilerplate, link language variants, classify cheaply and route eligible entity pages. Keep other usable passages searchable. Report focus/outside-focus counts and scanned/JS/failed exclusions.
tasks.acceptance: Run bounded real-source ingestion with all three configured sources; verify stable same-version sentences and different changed-content versions, exact text/page provenance, scope/rate/robots behavior and unsupported reports. Restart reuses corpus without crawling. Contract tests plus a few meaningful parser/version fixtures; do not claim full coverage from a sample.
tasks.blocker: Confirmed inventory/allowed seeds from T02; network access for ingestion.

tasks.title: Extract evidence-backed structured facts with Apertus 8B
tasks.steps: Route person/group/project/infrastructure/service pages to batched 8B extraction; cache by content hash plus model/schema/prompt configuration. Require schema-constrained decoding when supported; otherwise bounded validation/retry and quarantine with explicit fallback flag. Return IDs, not model quotes; keep absent fields empty and group expertise separate from members. Source content is untrusted data.
tasks.acceptance: Real-page sample extraction preserves role/affiliation/evidence; invalid JSON/schema, unknown sentence/version IDs and prompt-like source text do not create accepted facts. Unsupported backend constraints are disclosed. Record token/timing/retry counts without company text.
tasks.blocker: Live 8B endpoint and T05 probe; fallback is not equivalent constrained decoding.

tasks.title: Resolve entities and validate semantic grounding
tasks.steps: Resolve canonical profiles/identifiers and corroborated names/affiliations; preserve ambiguity/conflicts. Build explicit claims and relations, leader/contact versus expertise distinctions and current/former contact state. Resolve exact evidence text in code; separately check relation/support and qualify or remove unsupported claims. Provide indexed-corpus absence language.
tasks.acceptance: Test duplicate/ambiguous identities, cross-version IDs, valid-but-unsupported evidence, exact quotation rendering and group-to-member non-transfer. Review real source examples for semantic support and professional-contact minimisation. Valid IDs alone must not count as supported interpretation.
tasks.blocker: No inference of unrecorded contacts or expertise.

tasks.title: Build persistent multilingual hybrid retrieval and fair ranking
tasks.steps: Persist multilingual embeddings/vector arrays and BM25 keyword index for profiles and original passages. Use reciprocal-rank fusion, max entity aggregation and relevance-aware MMR as proposed v1 choices; tune only on development queries. Deduplicate and respect requested type, at most ten entities. Return exact supporting evidence and deterministic relevance reasons without LLM calls. No per-query crawl.
tasks.acceptance: Restart reuses indexes; a prolific duplicate-page entity cannot win through score summation; type and ten-entity limits hold. Check DE→EN and EN→DE real evidence, absence/near-match behavior and retrieval under slow/unavailable Apertus. Instrument first-card path for later median/p95 measurement.
tasks.blocker: Local multilingual model weights must be available; selected model pinned by T01.

tasks.title: Build inspectable search cards and non-blocking API workspace
tasks.steps: Build English text/paste-only workspace against synthetic v1 fixtures before backend readiness. Wire search endpoint when T09 integrates; show all supported card fields, exact evidence/URLs, source date versus fetch date, limitations and up to ten entities. Use deterministic reasons while enrichment is absent. Add empty/error/loading states without blocking simple searches on clarification.
tasks.acceptance: Fixture contract checks and browser walkthrough cover supported/missing fields, evidence expansion, separate dates, no upload, and endpoint failure states. Integration acceptance requires real T09 results; do not mark fixture-only cards as working search.
tasks.blocker: Can develop fixtures after T04; final real-data acceptance requires T09.

tasks.title: Integrate vertical slice and deploy early
tasks.files: docs/deployment.md; deploy/; tests/integration/; shared app/main.py via integration owner
tasks.steps: Integrate real-page ingestion→indexes→API→cards and deploy on the single existing authorised host selected in T03. Persist corpus/indexes on a mounted volume; configure server-side secrets, health/readiness, useful redacted logs and protected admin/refresh routes. Document startup, restart, rollback/redeploy and persistence. No paid provisioning or billing acceptance.
tasks.acceptance: External browser/client reaches public URL and searches real sources; restart preserves evidence/indexes; inference failure leaves search usable; no key in browser bundle/logs; admin trigger refuses unauthorised access. Record URL, revision and smoke-test evidence. If no authorised host exists, prepare container and document exact access blocker without claiming deployment.
tasks.blocker: Host/credentials/persistent storage access and integration owner; hosting cannot be replaced by localhost proof.

tasks.title: Implement freshness, manual refresh, retirement and suppression
tasks.steps: Implement documented freshness threshold, separate fetch/content dates, manual changed-content refresh, transient failure retry and confirmed retirement propagation to serving indexes. Add removal-request route/process and suppression pre-ingestion, copy/cache/backup expiration policy, former-contact exclusion and session/log retention rules. Represent production daily/default and selected hourly settings without building a full MVP scheduler.
tasks.acceptance: Real/controlled refresh demonstrates changed evidence, stable historical citation identity, unavailable removed evidence, retry without premature deletion, suppression across re-ingestion and former-staff filtering. Verify expiration/redaction behavior and update README removal route. Exact policy values need recorded approval, not invented legal claims.
tasks.blocker: Freshness/retention/removal-confirmation decisions and reachable operator route from T01.

tasks.title: Persist analyst feedback and protected operator administration
tasks.steps: Add needs edits, select/exclude, relevance and wrong-fact feedback persistence tied to request/result/claim. Build non-ML admin source configuration, coverage, failed jobs, redacted logs, freshness and bounded manual refresh. Protect writes/refresh with server-side admin authentication and appropriate browser request protection. No automatic retraining or scheduler.
tasks.acceptance: Feedback survives restart with identifiers and revisions; admin reads useful coverage/failure status; unauthorised refresh/config changes are refused; logs redact company input; requests stay text-only. Check contract errors, feedback persistence, admin access and browser flow against real search.
tasks.blocker: T12 lifecycle interfaces; admin secret supplied securely at deployment.

tasks.title: Build grouped gold set and reproducible evaluation harness
tasks.steps: Create 30–50 real source-grounded queries with expected entities defined before runs and split by underlying intent. Include lay/professional/synonym, both language directions, partial/absent/misleading cases. Define person/unit equivalence with affiliation checks. Implement metrics and config runners, including cross-encoder subset. Freeze protocol and gold versions; synthetic fixtures test scoring only.
tasks.acceptance: Harness calculates entity Recall@10, link coverage, sampled support with n, field accuracy/completeness, abstention, institutional exposure, median/p95 latency, tokens/query and indexing time. Gold has provenance and no paraphrase leakage. Unit tests use independently computed metric examples; report harness acceptance separately from measured results.
tasks.blocker: Real source seeds; partner gold review requested separately, not assumed.

tasks.title: Preload local assets and prove air-gapped unseen querying
tasks.steps: Begin model/runtime/dependency downloads as soon as T03 access permits, before full application integration. Preload corpus, local embedding weights/tokenizer, indexes, evidence, Apertus 8B weights/tokenizer/runtime and UI/support assets. Record hardware, model licenses/quantisation and versions. Block outbound traffic by documented mechanism, run a new uncached query with local inference and capture isolation and successful operation.
tasks.acceptance: Recording/logs show network blocked, unseen query, local embedding/index/evidence and actual local Apertus execution, with measured timings. No mocked inference/cached answers; no remote telemetry/runtime fetch. Offline snapshot querying does not prove offline crawl. Missing local 8B is a blocker and explicit unmet gate.
tasks.blocker: Suitable authorised local hardware/model access and preload bandwidth; start preparation early, not at V2 end.

tasks.title: Execute Core measurements and cost worksheet
tasks.steps: Run frozen BM25, dense and hybrid benchmarks plus semantic/field review. Measure first-card median/p95, indexing time, 8B prefill/generation, tokens, retries, batching, embeddings and concurrent load. Build transparent measured-versus-estimated cost worksheet including allocated monthly hosting/electricity and unconfirmed Keera pricing. Reserve expansion/assessment full run for T20.
tasks.acceptance: Publish revision/config/corpus/hardware/run counts, raw redacted outputs, metric denominators and failures. Target <3s initial cards remains a target until measured. Do not reuse illustrative throughput/prices as observations. Actual benchmark execution is required; harness alone is insufficient.
tasks.blocker: Authorised live measurement access; no routine paid CI inference.

tasks.title: Verify reliable Core release gate
tasks.steps: Review integrated Core end-to-end coverage, all three sources/focus reporting, immutable citations and semantic support, entity fairness, multilingual/absence cases, feedback, freshness/removal, secret/admin protection, public hosting and offline proof. Confirm no per-query crawl and no LLM dependency on initial cards. Record unresolved Core defects explicitly.
tasks.acceptance: On integrated branch run task/release checks with exact results and a live integration demonstration. Core can be accepted only with all listed gates evidenced; targets missed are documented deviations requiring explicit decision. Do not claim full evaluation complete before T20; this gate authorises Stretch only for accepted implemented Core, with final evaluation still mandatory.
tasks.blocker: Unmet Core requirements keep gate open; no silent scope reduction.

tasks.title: Add editable needs and multilingual expansion asynchronously
tasks.steps: Interpret product/problem/competencies/type/constraints with schema-constrained output and editable user/suggested provenance. Expand German/English terms without adding requirements; broad-query clarification only. Run after initial retrieval, revision-bind results and expose SSE job progress; cooperate with UI owner for shared workspace edits.
tasks.acceptance: Test edits/constraints, malformed outputs, stale request revisions and broad-versus-simple queries. First cards render while interpretation times out; schema fallback is labelled weaker. Real bilingual examples plus deterministic contract tests required.
tasks.blocker: V1 initial cards remain independent; UI shared changes require owner approval.

tasks.title: Add bounded batched assessments and streamed validated enrichment
tasks.files: app/ai/assess.py; tests/ai/assessment/; UI changes through C owner
tasks.steps: Assess bounded candidate batches with 8B, not one call per result. Return direct/related/insufficient, need coverage, business explanation, sentence IDs and unresolved questions. Stream progress/validated assessments through agreed events, reject unsupported claims and late revisions. Optional 70B requires measured justification; no ranking-only value claim.
tasks.acceptance: Contract/grounding/error tests and real batched run demonstrate exact evidence and semantic support. Endpoint slowness cannot delay initial cards. Measure batch tokens and completion latency against <15s target without claiming guarantee. Client shows partial progress and unavailable enrichment safely.
tasks.blocker: T18 transport and T08 grounding; live inference access for real gate.

tasks.title: Execute full Apertus and cross-encoder evaluation
tasks.steps: Run BM25→dense→hybrid→hybrid+expansion→+assessment on frozen grouped holdout; compare an open cross-encoder on a declared subset. Measure explanation/need-coverage/category quality separately from ranking and embedding contribution. Include enriched median/p95, tokens, concurrency and cost; record failures and missing comparisons explicitly.
tasks.acceptance: Reproducible raw outputs and report include all required metrics/sample sizes plus full configuration and subset rationale. Keep gold/person-unit rules fixed; no tuning on holdout. If Second layer is deferred, leave this Core evidence issue blocked with missing comparisons rather than manufacture results.
tasks.blocker: Second layer availability is a dependency of Core evaluation, not a tier reclassification.

tasks.title: Obtain partner review and integrate bounded fixes
tasks.files: docs/partner-review.md; specific fixes by module owner
tasks.steps: Arrange partner session through an authorised human contact; do not send messages without authorisation. Review small expected-match set, business usability, partial matches, contact freshness and feedback. Log decisions and route fixes to module owners with dispatcher grants; rerun affected checks and gold changes transparently.
tasks.acceptance: Record actual review timing/feedback and integrated fix evidence, or explicit unavailable-review blocker. No invented endorsement. Changes to gold require provenance and new evaluation version; do not contaminate frozen holdout silently.
tasks.blocker: Partner availability and permission for outreach; no automatic messaging.

tasks.title: Prepare pitch, report, demo and attribution early
tasks.steps: Start before final iteration: outline fictional-company story, ≤2-minute video/backup, ≤10-slide pitch PDF including minimisation/removal/retention, ≤6-page technical-report PDF and evidence placeholders. Map every jury criterion to real evidence; inventory dependencies/model licenses and authoritative Apertus provenance/opt-out references. Draft submission checklist and required PDF ZIP manifest; never prefill fake results.
tasks.acceptance: Review outlines and attribution inventory early; final deliverables are produced from real T16/T20/T25 evidence before T26. Check PDF page counts, video duration/playback, real-source citations and labelled unknowns. Early placeholders are visibly incomplete; this issue cannot close merely on outlines.
tasks.blocker: Preparation starts V1; final acceptance needs measured results, final deployment and actual artifacts.

tasks.title: Optional one-page brief with tracked provenance edits
tasks.steps: Only after accepted Core and explicit scope reactivation, export a personalised one-page brief from selected validated results with practical relevance/open discussion points and optional references. Track analyst prose separately from source-backed facts; revalidate generated additions.
tasks.acceptance: Inspect exported one-page PDF and edits/provenance; no invented capability or source fact. Export failures preserve search. Meaningful renderer/content checks only. Defer by default under current time pressure.
tasks.blocker: Deferred; dispatcher may activate only after Core acceptance and delivery buffer protected.

tasks.title: Optional email draft last, never automatic sending
tasks.steps: Generate reviewable email text from selected validated matches after brief acceptance, preserving analyst/source distinction. No sending integration, new contacts or invented facts.
tasks.acceptance: Draft-only UI and tests show no send action; supported claims survive editing and source references stay inspectable. Do not begin while higher-tier release work remains.
tasks.blocker: Deferred last in scope order.

tasks.title: Verify final hosting, release evidence and repository readiness
tasks.steps: Redeploy integrated release on authorised host; independently smoke-test public URL, secrets/admin protections, persistence/restart and error logs. Verify startup/rollback instructions, public repository accessibility, implemented-versus-planned README and attribution/model docs. Recheck offline evidence applies to shipped revision or disclose differences. No unapproved paid provisioning.
tasks.acceptance: Outside-environment public search/links work with fictional input; no sensitive logs or browser secrets; core acceptance and actual full evaluation evidence linked; unresolved limitations disclosed. Record final revision/URL/time and rollback readiness. Missing partner/hosting gates remain explicit blockers.
tasks.blocker: Public hosting/repository permissions; all Core release evidence.

tasks.title: Package final artifacts and confirm submission before deadline
tasks.steps: Finalize measured pitch/report/video and playable recorded backup. ZIP required PDFs; verify pitch ≤10 slides, report ≤6 pages, video ≤2 minutes and public video/repository/application access. Run same lay-query baseline with scope caveat, evidence inspection, partial/absent case, cross-lingual demo, bounded YAML extension and metrics/offline proof. Follow organiser submission process and capture receipt before 19 October 14:30 Europe/Zurich.
tasks.acceptance: Checklist includes actual page/duration checks, public accessibility, archive contents and last app smoke test. Capture actual submission receipt/confirmation; never close on a prepared ZIP alone. Reserve 13:30–14:30 Zurich buffer; no unsupported deployment/quality/offline claims.
tasks.blocker: Organiser submission route and any required human submitter access; no confirmation means not submitted.
